head_epilogue_1

builder_edits.before: require(template.count(expr) == 2 and candidate.count(expr) == 2, "Preserve LOCAL native head accumulation expression twice")
builder_edits.after:
require(template.count(expr) == 2 and
            candidate.count("#pragma clang fp contract(off) reassociate(off)") == 2 and
            candidate.count("const float weighted = max(s, 0.0f) * w[head];") == 2 and
            candidate.count("const float scaled = weighted * args.scale;") == 2 and
            all(candidate.count(f"acc{part} = scaled + acc{part};") == 1 for part in (0,1)),
            "V2 exact local head mul/mul/add with contraction and reassociation disabled")

motivation: Native/candidate AIR have same fast mul/mul/add; independent CPU 36/36 visible-cell models predict native separate head ops vs candidate fused head; this v2 is one locally constrained falsifiable change, not GPU proof.
